title: Fix off-by-one in pagination cursor for the list endpoint
body:
Closes #42

## Problem

The list endpoint skips the last item of every page because the cursor is advanced one past the final element.

## Risk

Low: the change is confined to cursor arithmetic and is covered by a new unit test.

## Test Plan

Added a table-driven test over page sizes 1, 2 and 50; ran the full suite locally.

## Rollback

Revert this commit.

## Monitoring

Watch the list endpoint error rate after deploy.

files.patch:
@@ -10,7 +10,10 @@
-	next := cursor + pageSize + 1
+	next := cursor + pageSize
